supervisor_rule: choose barrier if physical margin <3 m; otherwise choose independent tracking if observer error >1.2 m/s; otherwise choose two-layer influence if residual exceeds the calibration 90th percentile; otherwise use permanent coupling
warning_rule: first time joint normalized margin falls below 0.2 while still non-negative
claim_boundary: The supervisor is a prespecified model-specific policy. The finite-game theorem dominates fixed action classes only for exact predecessors; empirical superiority is not guaranteed.
